description: This file contains C source code implementing cache manipulation routines for a specific hardware platform (Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards). It includes functions for flushing cache lines, referencing external cache control headers, and defining inline assembly cache operations. The file is part of a LZMA kernel loader, as indicated in its comments, and is tailored for embedded system firmware within the OpenWRT project.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes caches for a specified memory range by performing cache writeback and invalidation on each cache line within the region.
